title: Understanding Model Bias
text: Adding a new feature to a model can affect its bias. Consider how adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature might impact the model's ability to fit the data.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature can potentially decrease the model bias if it captures additional information about the data. However, it might also increase bias if it introduces noise.

title: Analyzing the Impact
text: Consider the effect of adding a feature that is the square of an existing feature on the model bias. Is it possible for the model bias to increase, decrease, or both?
